resolution: The user requested removing the authority flag. Valid streamer receipts now use the same lifecycle path without caller opt-in; the four proposed caller changes are no longer needed.
request: Allow explicit callback-authority opt-in at verified native streamer construction sites
reason: RapidaSource is read from incoming metadata on external gRPC, so PhoneCall alone cannot establish receipt authority. The adapter defaults authority to false and provides WithPlaybackCompletion for explicit caller wiring.
proposed_paths: Corresponding existing *_test.go files in each package
proposed_behavior: Opt in only native WebRTC and native telephony/SIP streamers with verified local playback receipts.
Keep external gRPC callback authority disabled regardless of incoming source metadata.
Do not change interruption rollout defaults or enable unsupported synthesis finality.
proposed_verification: Focused constructor tests: native owners opt in, external gRPC remains diagnostic-only
just agent-finalize with exact additional source and test inventory
